[[File:Skipray2.jpg|thumb|right|180px|GAT-12 Skipray blastboat]]
The '''GAT Blastboat series''' was produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], and was the standard [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for patrol and point combat missions. [[Blastboat/Legends|Blastboats]] were fast and agile enough to intercept most intruders, and were armed and armored enough to deliver an offensive punch and withstand weapons fire. Blastboats operated both in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The GAT Blastboat was the smallest [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to be equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and were deployed throughout a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] where combat was expected.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Multiple variants of the GAT Blastboat were produced, including specialized configurations for ground support or missile platforms. The most popular variant was the [[GAT-12h]] "Skipray".<ref name="ISB" />

The 12h was also successful in the open market, and refined [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|GAT-12]] models were released over the years, being the [[GAT-12i]] and [[GAT-12j]] the most prominent.<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|skipray|Skipray blastboat}}</ref>

The series later included the [[Skipray 24r Blastboat]].
